[assistant] Done. I analyzed all 12 flagged tables (the non-"Match" rows in your filtered view) across SPAU, SPDD, and CCLM.

**Key findings:**

*SPAU / SPDD* — None of the 12 tables appear in any SPAU or SPDD workbook. That's expected: SPAU/SPDD only cover SAP-standard objects with customer modifications or note corrections, and these are all customer-owned `/CCBJI/` tables, so they're out of scope by design. (The SPDD files do contain *other* `/CCBJI/` objects, so the search is valid — these specific ones just aren't there.)

*CCLM last used* — All 12 are in "CCBJI Latest List from CCLM.xlsx", but every one has **Usage Flag = 0, a blank Last-Used date, and execution frequency 0** — CCLM logged no runtime usage. The "Last Found" date (2026-05-07) is just the scan discovery date, not a usage date. Caveat worth noting: despite no logged execution, all 12 are heavily referenced in custom code per the where-used log (e.g. T_AWH_IF has 2,501 references, T_AWH_SHP 1,979).

*Add-on analysis (your follow-up)* — Only **`/CCBJI/LG_PACK_I`** is part of an add-on: it belongs to package `/CCBJI/ORTEC_LEO` (the ORTEC add-on) and appears in `AddOn_Ortec.xlsx`. The other 11 are **not** in any add-on analysis — 10 belong to the customer package `/CCBJI/FTD` and one (T_DLT_LOG) to `/CCBJI/RTR`, both Coca-Cola custom packages rather than third-party add-ons.

The workbook has a "Table Analysis" tab (per-table detail with all the above plus an assessment column) and a "Summary & Method" tab. The biggest action item: the 4 "Missing in S4" and 2 "Critical" tables hold large ECC volumes that didn't reach S/4 — those need a business decision on obsolete vs. migration gap.

[assistant] Checked. **None of the 12 flagged tables appear in the activation/upgrade (ACT_UPG) logs.** 

The `act_upg` folder itself is empty — the actual logs live in `01_Activation_Upgrade_Logs` (ACTUPG.ELG, ACTUPG.LOG, ACT_UPG.txt, ACT_UPG _C0_OLD.txt, ACTUPG_Issues_Categorised.xlsx, etc.). I searched all of them. The logs *do* contain other `/CCBJI/` objects (e.g. `/CCBJI/CONT_UP`, `/CCBJI/UNIT_PRC`, `/CCBJI/ZABSS_*`), so the search is valid — none of your 12 tables raised an activation or upgrade error.

So across the full picture now: these tables had no activation/upgrade issues, were not in SPAU or SPDD, and show no recorded CCLM usage — only `LG_PACK_I` ties to an add-on (ORTEC).
